title: AI Agent生态加速成熟：云厂商竞相布局多Agent协作与AI安全，基础设施进入智能应用时代
core_insight: AI代理技术正从概念验证走向企业级规模化部署，云厂商通过基础设施深度整合、多Agent协作平台和安全防护构建，推动云计算竞争进入智能应用层

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud在KubeCon EU 2026展示GKE作为AI基础设施核心平台，llm-d成为CNCF沙盒项目，Kubernetes正式成为万亿参数AI模型基础设施标准；微软推出首个端到端Agentic现代化解决方案，Cloudflare发布Dynamic Workers实现AI生成代码安全沙箱执行，速度提升100倍 Cloudflare Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin处理器，边缘计算性能提升2倍；AWS推出S3账户区域命名空间功能，NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super登陆Amazon Bedrock，AI基础设施持续优化 The open platform for the AI era: GKE, agents, and OSS innovation at KubeCon EU 2026 Kubernetes as AI Infrastructure: Google Cloud, llm-d, and the CNCF Many agents, one team: Scaling modernization on Azure Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Launching Cloudflare’s Gen 13 servers: trading cache for cores for 2x edge compute performance AWS Weekly Roundup: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Amazon Bedrock, Nova Forge SDK, Amazon Corretto 26, and more Next-gen caching with Memorystore for Valkey 9.0, now GA
dimension_texts.infrastructure: Cloudflare推出自定义区域服务，允许客户精确定义地理边界以满足数据主权要求；今日无显著定价变化公告 Cloudflare Gen13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin 9965处理器，网络升级至100GbE；Google Ironwood TPU支持大规模AI模型训练；微软与NVIDIA合作加强Azure AI基础设施 Introducing Custom Regions for precision data control A developer’s guide to training with Ironwood TPUs Microsoft at NVIDIA GTC: New solutions for Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI infrastructure and Physical AI Inside Gen 13: how we built our most powerful server yet FabCon and SQLCon 2026: Unifying databases and Fabric on a single data platform
